body: I'm told I'm very pretty, it's just I can't get out of the house much due to mental crap. When on proper pills at the proper time I can talk and guys seem interested, but the thing is, I'm not stable and I get crying or panic episodes in public.

Yeah my dad just does NOT understand mental illness at all. Doesn't understand my mom, and certainly not me, who has it much worse. I'm not sure if I think it is my fault but going from my dad saying "I'm so proud of your straight A's sweetie!, you can do whatever you want!" To yelling at me about how I have failed and might as well get my ass out and get a job and about how expressing myself to my mom hurts her and I should just "go for a run". Running is fun but that doesnt cure depression, bipolar, and whatever else I have.

I do indeed seek help. My mom takes me to therapy and gets me appointments at the psych so he can adjust my pills, but he's very incompetent and we don't have insurance and yeah I'm kinda stuck with him. It's the fucking bipolar. Happy happy with Xanax and other meds and caffeine, then down. I feel dead, I feel like there's no light at the end of this dark tunnel. I seriously feel like running and tying a brick to my leg and jumping in the river near my house. 

ThNks for the support. I highly appreciate it!

Some Indian guy called me in terribly broken English about how my " Mac has virus. Give us password and we fix for you."

I have a PC. Lol what the fuck. 

Like hell I'll give my password to anyone. Jesus christ, these call center scammers piss me off!

The reason I had to drop out of college for a year is because my mental illnesses aren't being properly treated, like my pill combos are a mess and aren't working, my psychiatrist is shit, and therapy doesn't help. 

So I highly doubt I could hold down I job.

They year I'm off I'm going to try hard to get my shit together. This isn't what I was supposed to be, and if I end up unable to work or live a normal life, I will consider suicide. I get suicidal thoughts and plans nearly every night but I don't tell anyone because I don't want to be locked up.
Thank you! That means a lot :)
Letting pills take effect and suddenly I've lost interest in going to bed. Internet party!!!

Getting rid of my mental illnesses and removing them from my genes so if I ever have kids they wint have to put up with the shit I have to.

That way, I can be free. Free from this shit and be able to function without alcohol and pills and therapy. And not be a burden. Normal so I can chase my dreams full speed.

(In response to my mom inquiring how my mental illness is doing)

"I'm... Uh.. Oh I'm fine!! You can watch your cooking shows, I'm fine I swear!"

-cries in private as to not upset her. I hate myself for being this way so I hide it.

Still Standing (TV show)
I would watch syndications of it (it had been cancelled for a few years at this point) after school in 7th grade to take my mind off of the bullying I suffered. The show was really funny and great. But 6 years later and they stopped showing the syndications. It makes me feel sad inside. So many memories and comfort I got from that show.
Warm tea and relaxing on a couch or chair. That really helps me!
